articles.title: Record-Breaking Cosmic Blast Kept Flaring for 27 Days
articles.summary: Astronomers found GRB 220706A, whose engine flared in X-rays for around 27 days, far longer than the previous record, and scientists still do not know what powered it.

articles.title: Meet D-Rex, a Giant Fungus Whose Family Began 65 Million Years Ago
articles.summary: Scientists in Yunnan found Dianjunus rex, the largest known fruiting body among ascomycete fungi, whose family may date back to just after the dinosaurs' extinction.

articles.title: Archaeologists May Have Found the World's Oldest Shipwreck
articles.summary: A wreck off Kekova, Turkey, is tentatively dated to 2700-2400 BCE from its pottery cargo, but the dating is still under consideration and not yet peer-reviewed.
